headline: Approved one-day liquor licenses for Elms Café and Catering and an entertainment license for the Worcester County Walk to End Alzheimer's; Skate Night license postponed.
summary: Approved one-day liquor licenses for three events by Elms Café and Catering. Approved a one-day live music license for the Worcester County Walk to End Alzheimer's. Postponed the Skate Night Worcester live music request to October 22, 2026.
decisions: Approved one-day liquor licenses for Elms Café and Catering events, 2-0.
Approved a one-day entertainment license for live music at the Worcester County Walk to End Alzheimer's, 2-0.
Postponed the one-day entertainment license request for Skate Night Worcester to October 22, 2026, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 2-0 to approve the one-day liquor licenses.
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 2-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license.
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the item to the October 22, 2026, License Commission meeting.

decision_titles: One-day liquor licenses for Elms Café and Catering

plain_text:
License Commission 
         Meeting Minutes 
   OCTOBER 13, 2026  
 
 
Attendance: 
 
Commissioners 
Present: 
 
 
Anthony Vigliotti, Chair 
Charran Fisher, Commissioner 
 
 
Commissioners 
Absent: 
Maritza Cruz, Commissioner 
Staff Present: 
 
 
 
Deborah Steele, Licensing  
 
 
 
   
 
This meeting was remote participation only 
 
 
Call to Order – 8:30 A.M.  
            
 
One Day Liquor & Entertainment Requests 
 
1. Elms Café and Catering (dba Simply Delicious Catering) 
185 Salisbury Street 
Request for one day liquor license 
• Friday-October 16, 2026-5:30 p.m.-9:30 p.m. 
              3 Salem Square 
• Thursday-November 5, 2026-5:30 p.m.-9:30 p.m. 
               425 Salisbury Street 
• Saturday-November 14, 2026-5:00 p.m.-10:00 p.m. 
 
Carl Persson, participating remotely, reviewed each of the events. He stated that he will have a TIPS 
certified bartender and alcohol will be purchased from a wholesaler.
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 2-0 to approve the one-day liquor licenses. 
List of Exhibits: Application for one day liquor licenses received and dated October 6, 2026. 
2. Worcester County Walk to End Alzheimer’s, Hanover Insurance Park 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music 
• Sunday-October 18, 2026-7:00 a.m. -Noon 
 
Beth Whitney, participating remotely, stated that this is for the annual walk for hunger and they 
will have police details and will place 10 porta potties at the site. 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 2-0 to approve the one-day entertainment license. 
List of Exhibits: Application for one day entertainment license received and dated November 7, 2026.  
3. Skate Night Worcester, Worcester Common 
Request for one day entertainment license for live music 
• Friday-October 23, 2026-6:00 p.m.-9:00 p.m. 
• Friday-October 30, 2026-6:00 p.m.-9:00 p.m. 
 
 
No one appeared for item. 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to postpone the item to the October 22, 2026, 
License Commission meeting. 
  
Adjournment 
 
Upon a roll call vote the Commission voted 3-0 to adjourn the meeting at 8:37 a.m.
